mechanism: Prochlorperazine may mask ototoxic symptoms from tobramycin, and both agents can potentiate CNS depression; tobramycin nephrotoxicity may be exacerbated by prochlorperazine-induced dehydration.
action: Monitor renal function, auditory function, and fluid status closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antiemetics if prolonged tobramycin therapy is required.
